initial.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a polished game monster DESIGN COMPARISON BOARD for an original Roblox fantasy collection game. Wide board, exactly 3 rows and 4 columns, 12 distinct full-body creatures, generous spacing, neutral warm ivory studio background, no scenery. Column headings exactly "1★", "3★", "6★", "9★"; row labels exactly "A", "B", "C". Every row is a distinct design family, each of its 4 columns shows that SAME individual species growing and evolving. Stage 1: adorable five-year-old equivalent, tiny baby proportions, large eyes, small limbs, charming and approachable. Stage 3: child, clearly taller and more elaborate, recognizable identity. Stage 6: teen, athletic and impressive with stronger fantasy features. Stage 9: muscular majestic young adult, significantly larger, visually striking and elegant, smooth sculpted low-poly geometry with sophisticated fantasy accents. Stages 1,3,6 have attractive carefully crafted block/voxel Roblox-like geometry (not crude boxes), progressively softer refined shapes. Stage 9 has a smooth stylized sculpted low-poly silhouette. Maintain core face, colors and motif through evolution while producing obvious major changes in silhouette, size, anatomy and adornments. All creatures shown from consistent three-quarter front angle, without rider, equipment, UI or stats. No Pokemon, no franchise characters, no copied existing creatures. Treat fantasy motifs as proposed alternatives, not final canon. No tiny illegible extra text. High-quality professional 3D creature art, expressive faces, elegant complementary colors and detail; not flat schematic or generic placeholder. Scale visibly increases from column 1 to 4 within each row but every model fits cell fully. Title exactly "MEADOW MOUSE". Original tiny mouse, four-legged rideable small fantasy mouse. A: cream and caramel mouse with a leaf sprout and clover tail motif, evolves into a handsome woodland mouse champion with elegant leaf mantle. B: pale lavender and ivory mouse with flower-bud ears and a petal tail, evolves into a graceful flower guardian with refined petal crown. C: warm peach and tan mouse with dew crystal details and long curled tail, evolves into a striking amber/dew fantasy mouse with delicate crystalline accents. Keep mouse ears, mouse nose, whisker hints and tail at all stages. Do not turn into a cat, bear, dragon or human.

meadowRevisions.prompt: Edit only row C of this design board. Keep title MEADOW MOUSE, headings 1★ 3★ 6★ 9★, all row labels, entire rows A and B, spacing, pose, stage scale, camera, overall polish and background unchanged. The user wants creatures belonging to a grassy meadow, so replace ALL orange crystals, gemstone crowns and gemstone tail ornaments in row C with fresh meadow motifs: tender grass blades, dew droplets, tiny white daisies, clover and gently curling vine tail. Keep row C peach-cream mouse identity, big ears and clear mouse nose, with a distinct fresh spring-meadow feel compared to row A's large leafy mantle and row B's lavender petal theme. Stage 1 very adorable tiny mouse with two grass-blade sprouts and dew on curled tail. Stage 3 taller child with grass collar and small daisies. Stage 6 athletic young mouse with refined grass tufts, vine tail and dew. Stage 9 imposing but charming adult meadow mouse with smooth low-poly anatomy, long flowing grass mantle and elegant daisy/vine head crest. No crystals, gold jewelry, fire, lava, artificial armor or extra creatures in row C. Do not change the headings or add text. This is proposed original fantasy game creature concept art.

Remove all gold hardware, all glowing veins, all orange/blue crystals. A: warm sandstone elephant with soft green grass tufts and tiny white daisies between pale sculpted stone plates, final a colossal sunlit meadow stone elephant with sweeping tusks and grassy back crest.
